title: Pseudorandom state
prompt: What happens when a generator consumes an additional draw?
source_solution: Its state advances, so later draws typically change. A seed alone is insufficient if operation order changes.

prompt: What must be recorded beyond a seed?

title: Parallel streams

title: Uniform mapping

title: Model versus data
prompt: Does a large simulation sample make a poorly specified model correct?

title: Confidence interpretation
prompt: What does nominal 95% coverage mean in frequentist repeated sampling?
